items.title: Leonard Bocage Interview, 1972-03-24
items.q: I just, I played with Pete in the brass band

ctx.x: What, what is your relation to Pete? Uh, how are you related to Pete? Pete's cousin, first cousin. Pete, Pete and Charlie and Henry are your cousins?
Yeah. Well, Pete and, uh, Pete and Piro and them come up together. After Piro died out, well, Pete, he found the Creole Serenators.
